在向导的不懈努力下，我们完成了[Root.GetName]上的提升项目。我们已经将[From.GetName]转变为一个完全智慧物种，而他们曾经称之为家园的创世保护区已经被改造成了一座创世纪念碑。

它将永远是这个物种进化成就的不朽见证。
texts.en:
After our guides' unceasing dedication, we have completed the uplifting project on [Root.GetName]. We have transitioned the [From.GetName] into a fully sapient species, and the Genesis Preserve, which they once called home, has been transformed into a Genesis Monument.

It will forever stand as an enduring testament to the achievement that was the evolution of this species.
